statementsToExecute:
CREATE TABLE "activity_preferences" (
	"owner" text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	"audience" text,
	"cover_path" text,
	CONSTRAINT "activity_preferences_audience_check" CHECK (audience = ANY (ARRAY['public'::text, 'followers'::text, 'private'::text]))
);
CREATE TABLE "activity_follows" (
	"follower" text NOT NULL,
	"followed" text NOT NULL,
	CONSTRAINT "activity_follows_pkey" PRIMARY KEY("follower","followed"),
	CONSTRAINT "activity_follows_check" CHECK (follower <> followed)
);
CREATE TABLE "activity_bookmarks" (
	"viewer" text NOT NULL,
	"owner" text NOT NULL,
	"hike_id" text NOT NULL,
	CONSTRAINT "activity_bookmarks_pkey" PRIMARY KEY("viewer","owner","hike_id")
);
CREATE TABLE "activity_route_reports" (
	"reporter" text NOT NULL,
	"owner" text NOT NULL,
	"hike_id" text NOT NULL,
	"reason" text NOT NULL,
	CONSTRAINT "activity_route_reports_pkey" PRIMARY KEY("reporter","owner","hike_id")
);
CREATE TABLE "activity_publications" (
	"owner" text NOT NULL,
	"hike_id" text NOT NULL,
	"audience" text NOT NULL,
	"updated_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
	"audience_revision" text DEFAULT '1970-01-01T00:00:00.000Z' NOT NULL,
	CONSTRAINT "activity_publications_pkey" PRIMARY KEY("owner","hike_id"),
	CONSTRAINT "activity_publications_audience_check" CHECK (audience = ANY (ARRAY['public'::text, 'followers'::text, 'private'::text]))
);
CREATE TABLE "recorded_hike_backups" (
	"owner_user_id" text NOT NULL,
	"hike_id" text NOT NULL,
	"snapshot" jsonb NOT NULL,
	"revision" text NOT NULL,
	"updated_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
	"deleted_at" timestamp with time zone,
	CONSTRAINT "recorded_hike_backups_pkey" PRIMARY KEY("owner_user_id","hike_id")
);
CREATE TABLE "activity_trail_suggestions" (
	"owner" text NOT NULL,
	"hike_id" text NOT NULL,
	"evidence_revision" text NOT NULL,
	"status" text DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
	"review_notes" text,
	"reviewed_at" timestamp with time zone,
	CONSTRAINT "activity_trail_suggestions_pkey" PRIMARY KEY("owner","hike_id")
);
ALTER TABLE "tracked_routes" ADD COLUMN "audience" text;
ALTER TABLE "activity_publications" ADD CONSTRAINT "activity_publications_owner_hike_id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("owner","hike_id") REFERENCES "public"."recorded_hike_backups"("owner_user_id","hike_id") ON DELETE cascade ON UPDATE no action;
